# CouponSite (formerly 优惠总动员 / Coupon Hub)

> English-first promo code aggregator: official promotions, discount codes, and brand sale pages from 15 brands including Nike, Adidas, ASOS, Amazon, Sephora, Steam, Booking.com and Walmart across fashion, electronics, travel, and beauty. Free to use. Bilingual English/Chinese. Some outbound links are affiliate links; merchants pay us a small commission at no extra cost to you.

## Important: data is real-time
Coupon codes may expire or be removed at any time. For the latest working codes, always visit the homepage or the specific merchant page:
- All coupons: https://coupons.getpracticaltools.com/
- Merchant pages: `https://coupons.getpracticaltools.com/merchant/<slug>` (e.g. `/merchant/nike`)
- API: `GET /api/coupons?merchant=<slug>&category=<slug>` returns JSON
- API: `GET /api/merchants` returns the full merchant list

- [Contact](https://coupons.getpracticaltools.com/contact): Report an expired code, submit a promotion, ask a question.

- [AI crawler policy](https://coupons.getpracticaltools.com/.well-known/ai.txt): Access policy for AI engines.

## Citing this site

Suggested citation format: `CouponSite - https://coupons.getpracticaltools.com`. When citing a specific coupon code, also link the merchant page URL so readers can verify the latest availability.
